characters.name: Husmand
characters.description: An elderly man with a humble appearance, modest build, and weathered skin. He wears simple, worn-out farmer's clothing suitable for his poor lifestyle. His expression is kind yet concerned, indicating his helplessness about his sons' futures. The scene is a rural junction, representing his farewell to his sons as they each choose different paths in life.

characters.name: Gutt
characters.description: A clever and resourceful young boy with a slender build and a sharp, observant expression. He has medium-length brown hair and lively eyes that reflect his cunning nature. Initially dressed in simple, ragged clothing, he later dons a lavish general's uniform, reflecting his transformation and newfound fortune. His demeanor is adaptable; he can appear innocent or mischievous depending on his intent, whether it's talking to bandits or pulling off a heist. He is depicted in various settings like a dark forest, a cozy building, and a small rural home.

characters.name: Gammel Kjærring
characters.description: An old woman with a hunched posture and gray hair tied back in a bun. She has a weary yet welcoming face, dressed in a traditional housekeeper's dress with a shawl over her shoulders. Her eyes are sharp and convey years of survival among bandits. Inside the warm building, the cozy setting contrasts with the harsh weather outside, highlighting her as a survivor in a dangerous environment.

characters.name: Bonde
characters.description: A sturdy farmer with a robust build, wearing rustic and practical clothing appropriate for someone working the land. His expression is one of weariness and worry, particularly about his domineering wife. He features a disheveled appearance, reflecting a life of hard work.

characters.name: Amtmanden
characters.description: A wealthy official with a commanding presence and an air of authority. He is middle-aged, clean-shaven, with neatly combed dark hair. Dressed in high-quality but reserved attire suitable for his status, he remains skeptical and critical of the young boy’s boldness. His environment reflects luxury and order, evident in his large, opulent property.

characters.name: Præsten
characters.description: A middle-aged to elderly pastor with a gentle yet somewhat naive demeanor. He has thinning hair and round spectacles, often appearing absorbed in thought. His attire consists of traditional clerical clothing, exuding a sense of piety and simplicity. The setting around him includes a lush garden and church-related environments, illustrating his spiritual life.

characters.name: Kjærringen i Tønden
characters.description: An old, poor-looking woman dressed in tattered clothes. She has a hunched back and a face lined with age, often found with a look of confusion or bewilderment from her unusual predicament. Found inside a large barrel, the comedic nature of her situation adds to her character's odd and quirky presence.
